adjudication.rationale: Diff changes the Calendar interface and CalendarManager to call `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`, and EventManager now creates multiple events for `event.destinationCalendar` entries (COLLECTIVE pushes multiple destination calendars). However, Office365, Lark, and BaseCalendarService ignore the passed `credentialId` and instead always derive the target calendar from `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` (i.e., destinationCalendar[0]) and use its `externalId` (e.g., O365 `eventsUrl` uses `mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId`, Lark uses it for `calendarId`, BaseCalendarService filters on it). This means when looping over multiple destination calendars/credentials, each credential can attempt to write into host #1’s external calendar ID rather than its own, leading to duplicates/missing events or API failures due to foreign calendar IDs. GoogleCalendarService is the only one shown selecting calendar by credentialId (`find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`).
